select per.*, su.student_no as studentNo, su.real_name as studentName, ps.scale_name as scaleName from psy_exam_record as per left join sys_user as su on per.student_id = su.user_id left join psy_scale as ps on per.scale_id = ps.scale_id
and su.student_no like concat('%',#{studentNo},'%')
and per.status = #{status}
order by create_time desc

select * ,su.real_name as studentName ,ps.scale_name as scaleName from psy_report as pr left join sys_user as su on pr.student_id = su.user_id left join psy_scale as ps on pr.scale_id = ps.scale_id where pr.record_id = #{recordId}
